help.first.title: First steps
help.first.1: Open Workspace settings. Add your roles (for example Product Owner) and your people with their hours per week.
help.first.2: Open Team. Add a team, then add its members (a person with a role) and set its cadence.
help.first.3: Open Meetings. Add recurring meetings with a time, a duration and the roles that take part.
help.first.4: See the result in Calendar (day by day), Weeks (week by week) and Load (hours per role and person).
help.first.example: To look around first, open the example workspace on the empty Calendar view.
help.where.title: Settings or assumptions?
help.where.caption: Where each value is edited
help.where.intro: Values for the whole workspace are in Workspace settings. Values that belong to one team are in the Team view.
help.files.title: Files and autosave
help.files.format: A workspace is one file named like plan.caldence.json.
help.files.buttons: New starts an empty workspace. Open reads a file. Save writes to the open file. Save as writes a new file.
help.files.fallback: Browsers without file access download the file on Save and ask for it on Open.
help.files.autosave: Caldence also saves your work in this browser, so a reload brings it back. Autosave is no replacement for saving a file.
help.files.privacy: Nothing is sent anywhere. Your data stays on your device.

help.templates.title: Templates
help.templates.apply: Apply: in the Templates view, choose Scrum, Kanban or SAFe, confirm the team name and select Create team. The new team gets its roles, cadence, categories and meetings. Undo removes it again.
help.templates.import: Import: select Import template file and choose a template file. Review the name, then create the team.
help.templates.export: Export: select a team, give the template a name and export it as a file you can share.
help.templates.people: A template holds no people. Add people in the workspace settings and assign them to roles in the team.
help.ics.title: Import into your calendar
help.ics.intro: Export a .ics file in the Import / Export view, then import it in your calendar app:
help.ics.outlook.title: Classic Outlook
help.ics.outlook.3: Choose Import an iCalendar (.ics) or vCalendar file, then select the file.
help.ics.outlook.4: Choose Import to add the items to your calendar.
help.ics.newOutlook.title: New Outlook and Outlook on the web
help.ics.newOutlook.2: Choose Add calendar, then Upload from file.
help.ics.newOutlook.3: Select the .ics file and the calendar to add it to.
help.ics.google.title: Google Calendar
help.ics.google.3: Select the .ics file and the calendar to add it to.
help.ics.apple.title: Apple Calendar
help.ics.apple.3: Choose the calendar to add the events to.
help.ics.note: Importing the same file again updates nothing yet. Delete the old entries first, otherwise they appear twice. Updating is planned for a later version.
